1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein the ratio of said polyalkylenimine to said polyanion is greater than 1:1.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine, and the ratio of said polyalkylenimine to said polyanion is greater than 1:1.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, and the ratio of said polyalkylenimine to said polyanion is greater than 1:1.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, wherein the ratio of said polyalkylenimine to said polyanion is greater than 1:1.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, and the ratio of said polyalkylenimine to said polyanion is greater than 1:1.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, wherein the ratio of said polyalkylenimine to said polyanion is greater than 1:1.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, wherein the ratio of said polyalkylenimine to said polyanion is greater than 1:1.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1, wherein the ratio of said polyalkylenimine to said polyanion is greater than 1:1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide, wherein the ratio of said polyalkylenimine to said polyanion is greater than 1:1.
